# bartools

```{r}
source("./plotBarcodeHistogram.R")
mixed <- perturb_top[, perturb_top$sampleMetadata$Subset %in% c("perturb", "null")]

## pull out sample designs
design_mixed <- mixed$sampleMetadata %>% as.data.frame()
design_mixed$sample <- colnames(mixed)

design_mixed$BarcodeSize <- as.factor(design_mixed$BarcodeSize)
design_mixed$Perturbation <- as.factor(design_mixed$Perturbation)
design_mixed$Subset <- factor(design_mixed$Subset, levels = c("null", "perturb"))
design_mixed$y = 1.05

## order samples
## order samples
order_sample <- design_mixed %>% with(order(Subset, Perturbation, BarcodeSize))

# colnames(mixed) <- factor(colnames(mixed), levels = colnames(mixed)[order_sample])

mixed_dge <- DGEList(
  counts = assay(mixed), 
  group = mixed$sampleMetadata$Subset)

## pull out ggplot data
p_mixed <- plotBarcodeHistogram(mixed_dge, orderSamples = colnames(mixed)[order_sample])
p_mixed

# ## combine sample design to ggplot data
# mixed_illus_df <- mixed_illus_df %>% 
#   left_join(design_mixed, by = "sample")
# 
# mixed_illus_df$y <- -0.1  # just for plotting the tile
# mixed_illus_df$height <- 1

p_mixed_illus <- p_mixed +
  ## label perturbations
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_tile(data = design_mixed, aes(x = sample,y = y, fill = Perturbation), height = 0.04, inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = list(`0` = "#C3FF85", `0.18` = "#DBB8FF", `0.27` = "#A951FF", `0.35` = "#7500EA")) +
  labs(fill = "Perturbation level") + 
  ## label libsize
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_tile(data = design_mixed, aes(x = sample,y = y+0.05, fill = BarcodeSize), height = 0.04, inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = list(`20000` = "#CFCFFF", `40000` = "#B2B2FF", `80000` = "#8282FF", 
                                  `160000` = "#4D4FFF", `330000` = "#1D1DFF", `660000` = "#0000B2"))+
  labs(fill = "Num. of cells") +
  labs(x = "Sample", y = "Barcode proportion") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

p_mixed_illus
```
